name: Pokopoko Gunshou ~Tana kara Koboreta Story~
original_name: ぽこぽこ軍将 ～棚からこぼれたストーリー～
source:
Main character found a strange UFO when cleaning his room. Inside were two aliens who came to this planet to spread military shogi game. Intimacy will be reward for winning.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-may-2001-sapphism-no-gensou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公打扫房间时发现了一个奇怪的UFO，里面有两名来到这颗星球推广军人将棋的外星人。赢得比赛便能获得与她们亲近的奖励。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-may-2001-sapphism-no-gensou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
